clues.text: When the LORD struck down the Egyptians, He would not let the destroyer enter homes with blood on the doorframe.
God told Israel to eat this meal in haste, fully dressed for travel, sandals on and staff in hand.
In the eighteenth year of King Josiah's reign, one was observed to the LORD in Jerusalem.
When Jesus was twelve years old, His family went up for this feast according to its custom.
At the table with His apostles, Jesus said He had eagerly desired to eat this meal with them before His suffering.
Pilate told the crowd it was their custom for him to release one prisoner to them at this time.
Writing to the Corinthians, Paul said Christ is the lamb of this feast, and He has been sacrificed.
